snippet.title: Creeper World 5 ALPHA Trailer
snippet.description:
Creeper World 5 is under development!  Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3563440/Creeper_World_5/

Engage the creeper again, except... what?!?  There are multiple creeper enemies now! 

Or, what is this...? Perhaps some have become corrupted and joined with the creeper! Fight against forces as you direct the creeper to destroy and consume worlds
